newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end firmer at 21.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end firmer at 21.75 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates firmed on Tuesday amid normal to below normal liquidity, traders said.
Rates ended at 21.75 percent, compared with Monday's close of 21.5 percent.

"Rates started surprisingly high at above 22 but fell back to 21.5 before ending higher on the day at 21.75 in normal to below normal liquidity," said Jozsef Laczi of ING Bank, adding that the market was generally quiet with only a couple of deals taking place.
